div.div: Today: the director runs the loop itself (plan, delegate one step, review). Planned (dashed): an asset pass (free CC0 assets you approve per set, docs/assets-design.md) and a plain dispatcher runs the task graph so Claude only plans, handles escalations and reviews milestones; local tokens are free, so failed tickets are retried before Claude spends any.
